Why this template

Built the way you would have built it

No page builder output, no thousand-line stylesheet of overrides. Semantic markup, SCSS variables and small modules you can actually read.

Bootstrap 5.3

Built on the current Bootstrap, customised through SCSS variables rather than overridden with !important.

Dark & light

Native colour modes with a persisted switcher, tuned so both themes hit WCAG AA contrast.

No jQuery

Thirty-eight features written as ES modules, tree-shaken into one small bundle.

Live search

Debounced fetch-based autocomplete with keyboard navigation and highlighted matches.

Watchlist

Add to watchlist from any card; state survives reloads through localStorage.

Mobile-first

A bottom navigation bar, swipeable rails and touch targets sized for thumbs.

RTL ready

A generated right-to-left stylesheet plus a live direction switch in the header.

Accessible

Skip links, focus management, ARIA on custom widgets and reduced-motion support.

Fast by default

Lazy images with intrinsic sizes, deferred scripts, minified assets, no web fonts to block render.

Straight from the studios
